## ATT&CK & Frameworks

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ⭐ [MITRE ATT&CK](https://attack.mitre.org/) | framework | B·I·A | 🆓 free | Globally used knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques based on real-world observations, used for threat modeling, detection and red/purple teaming. |
| [ATT&CK Navigator](https://mitre-attack.github.io/attack-navigator/) | tool | B·I | 🆓 free | Web app to annotate and visualise ATT&CK matrices, e.g. detection coverage or actor profiles. |
| [Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain](https://www.lockheedmartin.com/en-us/capabilities/cyber/cyber-kill-chain.html) | framework | B | 🆓 free | The original intrusion kill chain model describing the stages of a targeted attack. |
| [MITRE D3FEND](https://d3fend.mitre.org/) | framework | I·A | 🆓 free | Knowledge graph of defensive cybersecurity countermeasures mapped to offensive techniques. |
| [The Unified Kill Chain](https://www.unifiedkillchain.com/) | framework | I | 🆓 free | Extended kill chain model unifying earlier models and ATT&CK into 18 attack phases. |
